The '''daughter''' of [[Viril Shu]], a corporate magnate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denon/Legends|Denon]], was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was kidnapped as an adult by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Kai Zykken]]. Instead of demanding a ransom, Zykken unsuccessfully attempted to woo Shu's daughter, hoping to marry into Shu's fortune.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>
